data.name: Harriman
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'heoran' meaning 'army' and 'mann' meaning 'man'. This name translates to 'ruler of the army' or 'ruler of the hearth'.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name signifies strength, leadership, and power. It is a name for those who are destined to lead and rule.
data.numerology_meaning: The number one is a symbol of new beginnings, leadership, and independence. Those with the life path number one are natural leaders and pioneers.

It serves as a reminder to live a courageous and virtuous life, leading others to the light of God.
